correctness.rationale: The class consists of exactly (7-1)!=720 cyclic orders, represented as permutations beginning 0, and each orientation query is a well-defined Boolean comparison of clockwise positions. A fresh independent full enumeration found all 128 response strings on the seven displayed triples. For the upper VC bound, relabeling acts transitively on oriented triples up to response complementation, so any shattered eight-support has a representative containing (0,1,2); an exhaustive 720-concept bitmask search applies the necessary 2^(8-k) remaining-witness bound to each partial response cell, pruning only branches that cannot extend, with surviving-prefix counts [0,1,28,290,1572,3669,2903,711,0]. This proves no eight-support. Separately the supplied depth-nine JSON was evaluated by a new JS implementation against all 720 concept rows, confirming 511 internal queries and 512 unique valid leaf witnesses with no split contradiction. Cardinality 720<1024 excludes depth ten. Independently direct enumerations of n=3..6 lower supports and concept-count upper bounds agree. The computation is exhaustive over this finite universe; no n>=8 claim is made.
